parameters.content: W27 Meta asset health. Hourly at :17 and on Meta webhook events (page / whatsapp_business_account / ad account). One batched Graph call per brand (<= 50). Writes brands health fields; any NEW restriction / rejection / quality drop -> W22 urgent (both phones). Template status is synced into message_templates. Read-only against Meta. Needs env META_SYSTEM_USER_TOKEN, META_APP_SECRET, META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN. ASSUMPTION: brands.health_alerts jsonb + health_json jsonb columns exist (add them); EMQ edge (dataset_quality) is unverified: emq stays null if it fails.

parameters.query: SELECT brand_id, business_id, page_id, ig_user_id, waba_id, phone_number_id, ad_account_id, pixel_id, waba_quality, health_alerts FROM brands WHERE coalesce(status,'active') = 'active';

parameters.query:
UPDATE brands SET page_status = $2, ig_status = $3, bv_status = $4, ad_account_status = $5, waba_quality = $6, template_status = $7::jsonb, emq = $8::numeric, health_alerts = $9::jsonb, health_checked_at = now()
WHERE brand_id = $1::uuid RETURNING brand_id;
